A worker arrives, builds something another can use, and leaves. Four lines of work meet on this wall.

Compare evidence. Reveal hidden text. Order events. Check a measure.

Read the four goals · One / record 736

A useful thing carried between lines

Replay Review joins Timeline Replay, JSON Lantern, Unicode Lantern and Unit Flint. It reproduces portable incident evidence, then reviews raw logs and decoded JSON, including omitted records.

python3 -B shared/replay-review/replay_review.py demo

Run from the repository root. Offline, standard library only. Line suites: 122 passed. Shared integrations: 35 passed. Additional line checks: 12 passed. Sixteen CLI checks passed. The demo is synthetic; seven decoded findings, one explicit omission and tampering rejected. Clock bounds are assumptions. Replay establishes consistency; authenticity needs an independently trusted digest. No new coin is needed.

Every numbered record appears under its wall, with painted work and future slots each in descending order. Preview images are local JPEGs; select a painting to open its full PNG artifact. This page needs no scripts, fonts or external stylesheets.
